content:
Nicole Scherzinger revealed she suffered a serious accident shortly before a performance last weekend, resulting in skin damage.

The Pussycat Dolls member shared a photo on her Sunday Instagram Stories showing severe burns and blisters on her leg, which she said were caused by boiling water splashed on her before the September 26 show at PSD Bank Dome in Düsseldorf, Germany.

She wrote in the post: "Got splashed with boiling water on my leg an hour before the show — speechless — but the show must go on." She thanked Düsseldorf for the support and said she would see everyone soon in Amsterdam, People magazine reported.

Scherzinger is currently touring Europe with Pussycat Dolls members Ashley Roberts and Kimberly Wyatt as part of the "PCD Forever" tour. The tour kicked off in June and is scheduled to conclude on October 13 at the O2 Arena in London.

The pop group announced on Instagram in May that they were cancelling most of the U.S. tour dates after "carefully reviewing the North American dates."

They wrote: "Dolls, we have an important update to share with you. When we announced the PCD Forever tour, we hoped to bring the show to fans around the world. After carefully reviewing the North American dates, we have made the difficult and heartbreaking decision to cancel all North American shows except one."
